Infinite Lo-Fi bundles separate FFmpeg 7.1 command-line executables built from
source with GPL, nonfree, and version-3 options disabled. FFmpeg reports its
resulting license as LGPL version 2.1 or later. The full license text is in
LICENSE-LGPL-2.1.txt.

The only statically linked external codec libraries are libvpx 1.16.0 and
Opus 1.5.2. Their BSD-style notices are in LICENSE-LIBVPX.txt and
LICENSE-OPUS.txt. macOS binaries link only to Apple system libraries.

See SOURCE.txt and manifest.json for source URLs, SHA-256 hashes, exact binary
hashes, and build scripts. Future application Releases must include all three
corresponding source archives alongside the installers; binary hashes and
configure flags are checked before packaging. No source is fetched when the
installed app runs.
